patho.caption_source: Brugada syndrome type 1. Note that V5 is placed one intercostal space above V1 (V1 IC4) and V6 is placed one intercostal space above V2 (V2 IC3). Type I morphology is seen in V1, V1 IC3 and V2 IC3. Furthermore, there is a horizontal QRS axis, broad P waves, wide S waves in the lateral and inferior leads and fractionation of the QRS complex in III and aVL.
patho.note: Type 1 en V1, V1 un espace plus haut, et V2 un espace plus haut. Pas de nom. L'auteur est celui du champ credit, le champ artist étant vide.
